steps.en: Install PyTorch for your GPU plus the requirements, then start the server
steps.zh: 装好对应显卡的 PyTorch 和依赖，启动服务

steps.en: Drop the model files you downloaded into the matching models/ subfolders
steps.zh: 把下载好的模型文件放进 models/ 下对应的子目录

steps.en: Serves the node-graph editor in your browser on port 8188
steps.zh: 在浏览器里提供节点图编辑器，默认端口 8188

component.zh: Python 服务端 + 网页前端

steps.en: Open a template or wire loader, text encoder, sampler and decoder nodes, then queue it
steps.zh: 打开模板，或自己连好加载、编码、采样、解码节点，然后排队执行

steps.en: Runs only the nodes whose inputs changed, moving weights between VRAM and RAM as needed
steps.zh: 只重跑输入变了的节点，按需在显存和内存之间搬动权重

steps.en: Saves the output with the whole workflow and seeds embedded in the file
steps.zh: 保存结果，文件里嵌着完整工作流和随机种子

value.en: A reusable, shareable generation pipeline on your own hardware — drag any output back in to get its exact graph
value.zh: 一条在自己机器上跑、可复用可分享的生成管线——把任何一张结果拖回来，就能还原它的整张图

sources: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/blob/master/README.md (Manual Install: pip install -r requirements.txt, python main.py; Put your SD checkpoints in models/checkpoints; Ctrl + Enter queues the graph; only changed parts re-execute; dragging a generated png restores the full workflow including seeds)
